blocks.prompt: 14 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\sqrt{2\sin^2 x + 1} = \sin x + \cos x\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein unknown square root ke andar hai, is liye root hatane ke liye dono taraf square karna parega.
Lekin yaad rakhiye (Example 3 ke saath wala Remember! box): square karne se extraneous roots (nakli jawab, jo hal karte waqt aate hain magar asal equation ko poora nahi karte) paida ho sakte hain.
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) mein sahi jawab aur general solution.
Plan: square karna, \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\) se simplify karna, factorise karna, har factor hal karna, phir har jawab ko asal equation mein rakh kar check karna.
Asaan misaal: \(x = 3\) ho to \(x^2 = 9\), magar \(x^2 = 9\) ke jawab \(3\) aur \(-3\) dono hain. Square karne se isi tarah ek nakli jawab andar aa jata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sqrt{2\sin^2 x + 1} = \sin x + \cos x \quad (1)\)
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: root hatane ke liye dono taraf square karenge (bilkul Example 3 ki tarah), phir \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\) lagayenge, factorise karenge, aur aakhir mein har value ko equation (1) mein test karenge. Test karna is sawal mein lazmi hai, optional nahi.

Dono taraf square karein
\[2\sin^2 x + 1 = (\sin x + \cos x)^2\]
\[= \sin^2 x + \cos^2 x + 2\sin x\cos x\]
\[= 1 + 2\sin x\cos x\]
Kyun: left side par root ka square karne se root khatam ho gaya. Right side par \((a + b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 + 2ab\) lagaya, aur phir \(\sin^2 x + \cos^2 x = 1\) wali buniyadi identity se do terms ek ban gayi.
Yaad rakhiye: square karne ke baad wali equation asal equation se zyada jawab rakh sakti hai, kam nahi. Is liye abhi jo bhi jawab milenge woh sirf 'umeedwar' (candidates) hain, pakke jawab nahi.

Sab ek taraf la kar factorise karein
\[2\sin^2 x - 2\sin x\cos x = 0\]
\[2\sin x(\sin x - \cos x) = 0\]
\[\sin x = 0 \text{ ya } \sin x = \cos x\]
Kyun: dono taraf ka 1 cancel ho gaya. Phir \(2\sin x\) common nikala, aur product zero hai to koi ek factor zero hoga.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin x\) se divide mat kijiye; aisa karne se \(\sin x = 0\) wale jawab ghayab ho jate hain. Common nikalna hi sahi tareeqa hai.
Socho ke agar hum \(\sin x\) se divide kar dete to sirf \(\sin x = \cos x\) bachta, aur \(x = 0\) jaisa sahi jawab hath se nikal jata.

Jab \(\sin x = 0\)
\[x = 0,\ \pi,\ 2\pi \quad [0, 2\pi] \text{ mein}\]
Kyun: sine yani y-coordinate sirf x-axis wale angles par zero hota hai: \(0\), \(\pi\) aur \(2\pi\).
Teen values isliye ke interval band hai aur dono kinare, \(0\) aur \(2\pi\), shamil hain.

Jab \(\sin x = \cos x\)
\[\tan x = 1\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{4},\ \pi + \tfrac{\pi}{4} = \tfrac{5\pi}{4}\]
Kyun: yahan \(\cos x\) zero nahi ho sakta (agar \(\cos x = 0\) ho to \(\sin x = \pm 1\) hota, jo \(\cos x\) ke barabar nahi), is liye \(\cos x\) se divide karna jaiz hai aur \(\frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \tan x\) ban gaya. Tangent positive hai to angle pehle (I) aur teesre (III) quadrant mein hai, reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).

\(x = 0\) aur \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\) ko (1) mein check karein
\[x = 0:\ \sqrt{1} = 1,\quad 0 + 1 = 1 \;\checkmark\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{4}:\ \sqrt{2 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2} + 1} = \sqrt{2}\]
\[\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} + \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \sqrt{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Remember! box ka hukm hai ke har mumkin jawab asal equation mein rakh kar dekhein. Dono values par left aur right barabar aaye, to yeh asli jawab hain. \(x = 2\pi\) par bhi bilkul \(x = 0\) jaisi values aati hain, is liye woh bhi sahi hai.
Check karte waqt hamesha asal equation (1) istemal karein, squared wali nahi; squared equation to har umeedwar ko qabool kar legi.

\(x = \pi\) aur \(x = \frac{5\pi}{4}\) ko (1) mein check karein
\[x = \pi:\ \text{L.H.S.} = 1,\ \text{R.H.S.} = -1\]
\[x = \tfrac{5\pi}{4}:\ \text{L.H.S.} = \sqrt{2},\ \text{R.H.S.} = -\sqrt{2}\]
Dono fail, is liye \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) extraneous roots hain.
Kyun: square root kabhi negative nahi hota, magar in values par right side negative hai. Asal mein yahan L.H.S. = \(-\)R.H.S. hai; square karne ke baad \(1^2 = (-1)^2\) ho jata hai, is liye squared equation in ko pakar nahi sakti. Yehi wajah hai ke check zaroori tha.
Graph mein bhi yeh saaf dikhta hai: blue curve (root wali side) hamesha x-axis se upar hai, jabke red curve \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) par neeche hai.

General solution
\[\{2n\pi\} \cup \left\{\tfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\]
Kyun: equation (1) ki dono sides \(2\pi\) ke baad dohraati hain (\(\sin x\) aur \(\cos x\) ka period \(2\pi\) hai), is liye har sahi value ke saath \(2n\pi\) jorte hain. \(0\) aur \(2\pi\) ek hi family \(2n\pi\) ke members hain.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(n\pi\) likhna ghalat hai; \(n\pi\) mein rejected value \(\pi\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{4} + n\pi\) mein rejected \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) wapas aa jate hain.
blocks.final_answer:
\([0, 2\pi]\) mein: \(x = 0, \frac{\pi}{4}, 2\pi\) (\(\pi\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{4}\) extraneous hain)
General solution \(= \{2n\pi\} \cup \left\{\frac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\right\}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)
